summary: Demon's Souls entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Demon's Souls
entries.definitive_edition: No definitive edition of the original. Use the PlayStation 3 version, preferably via RPCS3 for high-fidelity original-content capture.

emulation.notes: RPCS3 marks Demons Souls playable and exposes game patches such as Unlock FPS, Skip Intro Videos, and Disable Motion Blur. The Archstones can restore online-style behavior through a private server for PS3/RPCS3, but it is unofficial.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS3 content rendered at high internal resolution and optionally 60fps through RPCS3.

primary.version: Original PlayStation 3 release via RPCS3 or PS3 hardware
primary.why: This entry is for FromSoftware's 2009 original, not the 2020 remake. The shipped game is on PlayStation 3 only. RPCS3 is the best high-fidelity preservation route because it can run the PS3 game with higher internal resolution and optional FPS/unblur patches while preserving the original content; original PS3 hardware remains the authenticity fallback.
primary.how_to_play: Use RPCS3 for high-resolution capture of the PS3 release, documenting any patches such as Unlock FPS or motion-blur removal. Use real PS3 hardware when testing original timing or private-server online behavior.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate the 2020 Bluepoint/Japan Studio remake with the 2009 FromSoftware original. Official PS3 servers shut down February 28, 2018; The Archstones is an unofficial preservation/private-server option, not the original official service.

entries.title: Demon's Souls Remake
entries.definitive_edition: The PS5 Digital Deluxe Edition is the most complete purchase package because it includes bonus in-game items and soundtrack, but the Standard Edition contains the full game route.

emulation.notes: Use native PS5/PS5 Pro hardware. There is no practical emulation route for the PS5 remake.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PS5/PS5 Pro output, with Performance/High Frame Rate or 4K/Cinematic mode depending on capture goal.

primary.version: Demon's Souls remake on PS5 / PS5 Pro Enhanced if available
primary.why: The remake released on PlayStation 5 only. It was rebuilt by Bluepoint/Japan Studio with new visuals, animation, audio, Fractured World, revised carry burden, Photo Mode, and modern PS5 features. Since there is no PC or other console release, PS5 is both the only shipped platform and the highest-fidelity route; PS5 Pro Enhanced support and the Digital Deluxe Edition bonuses should be noted for complete capture planning.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS5 version on PS5 or PS5 Pro. Use High Frame Rate/Performance mode for 60fps capture, and sample 4K/Cinematic mode or PS5 Pro Enhanced output for visual comparison. Use Digital Deluxe Edition if the archive wants the bonus armor, shield, weapon, souls, grains, ring, and soundtrack documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a remake/remastered release of the 2009 PS3 game, not the original. Keep the PS3 original entry separate for original art direction, mechanics, timing, and server-history preservation.
